| `Store::tabs`<br>`lib.rs` | `Vec<TabRow>` in listing order | (realm, league); live only | PK-prefix seek on `tabs` + per tab an indexed count over `items` and a `json_extract`; temp b-tree for the order | `acq tabs`, MCP `tabs` | cli, mcp |

| `Store::status`<br>`lib.rs` | `Status` (path, bytes, 12 row counts) | nothing | 12 counts, one scan per table (`items` twice) + two `json_each` aggregations over live characters | `acq store status`, MCP `store_status`, `acq refresh` before/after | cli, mcp, daemon (tests only) |

Deliberately not in the table (not a search consumer's reads):

- `jobs::JobDb / Persisted` — the persisted job queue (`daemon.db`) — the daemon's, and `acq jobs` when no daemon runs
- `Store::record` — the write door, the daemon's alone (C28)
- `Store::rebuild` — re-extracts every derived column from each row's own json (`acq store rebuild`)
- `Annotations::put / delete / export` — the intent write door (C65, C66) and its `VACUUM INTO` backup
